slug: 2024-07-05 Congo - Council of Ministers approves bill creating National Personal Data Protection Commission

systems.system: Commission nationale de protection des données à caractère personnel (National Personal Data Protection Commission)
systems.owner: Republic of Congo (Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy presented the bill)

note: The 3 July 2024 cabinet approval is of a bill creating the commission (authority class), not of a general data protection law; it only says it strengthens existing legislation.
